I have completed the tasks for **B2-014-015** (Phases 3D-014: Navigation & Views and 3D-015: Selection in 3D).

### Deliverables Summary

1. **Progress Notes:**
   - Logged live running progress in [B2-014-015.notes.md](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/DOCS/3D/tasks/B2-014-015.notes.md).

2. **Phase 3D-014 — Navigation & Views (`src/core/3d/camera/`):**
   - [viewCamera.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/camera/viewCamera.ts): Immutable `ViewCamera` model, `orbit` (with pitch clamped within `[-PI/2 + 1e-4, PI/2 - 1e-4]`), `pan` (target moves in view plane so world tracks pointer), exponential `dolly`, `zoomToPoint`, `flyStep`, `viewMatrix` (glTF right-handed look-at), `projectionMatrix` (perspective & orthographic), `cameraPosition`, Blender standard views (`setStandardView` for "front", "back", "left", "right", "top", "bottom"), `toggleOrtho` (preserves apparent object scale), `frameBounds`, `frameAll`, `viewFromObjectCamera`, and canonical `VIEW_COMMANDS`.
   - [gestures.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/camera/gestures.ts): Pure mapping `navigationFromGesture(event)` for mouse (middle orbit, shift+middle pan, ctrl+middle dolly, wheel dolly), trackpad (two-finger scroll orbit, shift pan, ctrl dolly, pinch dolly), and touch (1-finger orbit, 2-finger pan/pinch).
   - [tape.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/camera/tape.ts): Replayable navigation macro sequence `TapeStep` and deterministic runner `runTape(cam0, tape)`.

3. **Phase 3D-015 — Selection in 3D (`src/core/3d/pick/`):**
   - [ray.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/pick/ray.ts): `rayFromScreen` generating normalized world rays for both perspective and orthographic cameras via inverse view-projection matrix with perspective divide.
   - [bvh.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/pick/bvh.ts): `three-mesh-bvh` spatial index caching per `(meshId, version)`, `pickMesh` taking `worldMatrix` into account with inverse-transpose normal transformation, and distance-sorted `pickScene`.
   - [select.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/pick/select.ts): Pure reducer `Selection3d` (`click` with Shift-toggle/activate and Ctrl-deselect, `selectAll`, `selectNone`, `invert`), `boxSelect` (replace/add/subtract modes), `lassoSelect` (2D polygon raycasting point-in-polygon), hierarchy `selectLinked`, `selectSimilar` (by type, material, or shared dataId), mesh topology flood-fill `selectLinkedFaces`, and canonical `SELECTION_COMMANDS`.
   - [outline.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/pick/outline.ts): `silhouetteEdges` extracting unique edges with dual adjacent face normals for the GPU outline shader pass.

4. **Unit Tests:**
   - [camera.test.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/__tests__/camera.test.ts): Tests for ViewCamera, orbit/pan/dolly, standard views, gestures, exact orbit invertibility (`orbit(+d)` then `orbit(-d)` returns to start within `1e-12`), and a 15-step navigation tape landing on an exact hand-computed 4x4 matrix within `1e-12`.
   - [pick.test.ts](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/__tests__/pick.test.ts): Tests for `rayFromScreen`, exact picks on 30 generated analytical test views against a known cube (<`1e-6`), 100k-face picking benchmark (<3 ms/ray), selection reducers, box/lasso, linked selection, face flood-fill, and silhouette edges.

5. **Handoff Document:**
   - Detailed handoff written to [B2-014-015.handoff.md](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/DOCS/3D/tasks/B2-014-015.handoff.md).
